item.title: Six months on, U.S. Navy families who evacauated Bahrain remain in limbo
item.description: When the U.S.-Iran war began, more than 1,000 dependents of U.S. Navy personnel in Bahrain were ordered to evacuate. After six months in temporary conditions, they want to know what the plan is.

item.title: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent to unveil new economic sanctions on Iran
item.description: The Trump administration calls this an "economic D-Day" on Iran. Iran vows to respond to fresh sanctions in a "seismic manner."
